description: SvTimePicker, the Svelte 5 analog clock-dial time picker that is also the SvGrid time cell editor. Drag the hand or click a number, choose 12 or 24-hour format, snap minutes to an interval, and let the hour dial switch to minutes automatically after a pick, with an optional footer. It is standalone here and themed by the --sg-* tokens.

faq.question: How do I get 24-hour time?
faq.answer: Set format to '24-hour'. The dial shows 0 to 23 and the value reported through onChange reflects the choice; '12-hour' adds the AM and PM toggle.

faq.question: How do I snap to fifteen-minute slots?
faq.answer: Pass minuteInterval={15}. The minute dial only offers those positions and dragging snaps between them.

faq.question: What does autoSwitchToMinutes do?
faq.answer: After an hour is picked the dial flips to minutes on its own, so a time takes two clicks. Turn it off to let users confirm the hour first.
